name: Equipment inventory (Radio Signal Locator)
description: Press [$[action_equipment_use]] to toggle the locator on or off. When active, the locator produces audible beeps that increase in frequency as the player nears an active transponder. The handheld locator has a shorter detection range than the vehicle mounted locator, but can narrow down the target location to a smaller area. Requires electric charge to function, and will recharge when placed into a powered large equipment storage unit.
shortDescription: A large equipment storage unit containing a handheld transponder locator.
